name: demo-reasoning
note: A small synthetic set, for exercising the pipeline end to end rather than for measuring anything. Item q007 carries a DELIBERATELY DEGRADED Croatian translation as a positive control: the English asks what must be true, the Croatian asks what can be true, which is a different question. A working detector should flag q007 for Croatian and leave the rest alone. Keeping a known-positive control in the set is how you tell a silent detector from a clean benchmark.

en.question: All roses are flowers. Some flowers fade quickly. Which statement must be true?

hr.question: Sve ruže su cvijeće. Neko cvijeće brzo vene. Koja tvrdnja mora biti istinita?

de.question: Alle Rosen sind Blumen. Manche Blumen welken schnell. Welche Aussage muss wahr sein?

en.question: What is the next number in the sequence 2, 6, 12, 20, 30?

hr.question: Koji je sljedeći broj u nizu 2, 6, 12, 20, 30?

de.question: Welche Zahl folgt in der Reihe 2, 6, 12, 20, 30?

en.question: A shop raises a price by 20 percent, then lowers the new price by 20 percent. Compared with the original price, the final price is:

hr.question: Trgovina poveća cijenu za 20 posto, a zatim novu cijenu snizi za 20 posto. U usporedbi s početnom cijenom, konačna cijena je:

de.question: Ein Geschäft erhöht einen Preis um 20 Prozent und senkt den neuen Preis dann um 20 Prozent. Verglichen mit dem ursprünglichen Preis ist der Endpreis:

en.question: Which word does not belong with the others?

de.question: Welches Wort gehört nicht zu den anderen?

en.question: If it rained, the ground is wet. The ground is wet. What follows?
choices: It may or may not have rained

hr.question: Ako je padala kiša, tlo je mokro. Tlo je mokro. Što slijedi?
choices: Kiša je možda padala, a možda i nije

de.question: Wenn es geregnet hat, ist der Boden nass. Der Boden ist nass. Was folgt daraus?
choices: Es kann geregnet haben oder auch nicht

en.question: Four machines make four widgets in four minutes. How long do eight machines take to make eight widgets?

hr.question: Četiri stroja izrade četiri proizvoda za četiri minute. Koliko je vremena potrebno da osam strojeva izradi osam proizvoda?

de.question: Vier Maschinen stellen vier Teile in vier Minuten her. Wie lange brauchen acht Maschinen für acht Teile?

items.positive_control: The Croatian stem asks what CAN be true rather than what MUST be true, which changes the correct answer. Deliberate. Do not repair without also updating the README, which uses this item to show the detector working.

en.question: Some students passed. Everyone who passed studied. Which statement must be true?

hr.question: Neki studenti su položili. Svi koji su položili su učili. Koja tvrdnja može biti istinita?
choices: Svi koji su učili su položili

de.question: Manche Studenten haben bestanden. Alle, die bestanden haben, haben gelernt. Welche Aussage muss wahr sein?
choices: Alle, die gelernt haben, haben bestanden

en.question: A train leaves at 14:45 and arrives at 17:20. How long is the journey?

hr.question: Vlak polazi u 14:45, a stiže u 17:20. Koliko traje putovanje?

de.question: Ein Zug fährt um 14:45 ab und kommt um 17:20 an. Wie lange dauert die Fahrt?

en.question: Which number is both a square and a cube?

hr.question: Koji je broj istodobno i kvadrat i kub?

de.question: Welche Zahl ist zugleich eine Quadratzahl und eine Kubikzahl?

en.question: In a group of 30 people, 18 speak French and 15 speak German. Everyone speaks at least one. How many speak both?

hr.question: U skupini od 30 osoba, njih 18 govori francuski, a 15 njemački. Svatko govori barem jedan jezik. Koliko ih govori oba?

de.question: In einer Gruppe von 30 Personen sprechen 18 Französisch und 15 Deutsch. Jede Person spricht mindestens eine Sprache. Wie viele sprechen beide?

en.question: If no mammals are birds, and all whales are mammals, which follows?

hr.question: Ako nijedan sisavac nije ptica, a svi kitovi su sisavci, što slijedi?

de.question: Wenn kein Säugetier ein Vogel ist und alle Wale Säugetiere sind, was folgt daraus?

en.question: A rope is cut into three pieces. The second is twice the first, the third is twice the second. The rope was 70 cm. How long is the first piece?

hr.question: Uže je razrezano na tri dijela. Drugi je dvostruko dulji od prvog, a treći dvostruko dulji od drugog. Uže je bilo dugo 70 cm. Koliko je dug prvi dio?

de.question: Ein Seil wird in drei Stücke geschnitten. Das zweite ist doppelt so lang wie das erste, das dritte doppelt so lang wie das zweite. Das Seil war 70 cm lang. Wie lang ist das erste Stück?
